'''Korvus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[Alien Control]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he developed a serum that would break the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] settlers of their stubborn fight-to-the-death attitude.<ref name="TOR" />
